Why active thermal control matters
Polymers shrink as they cool from extrusion temperature, and high-performance materials like PEEK and PEKK shrink unevenly enough to cause warping and weak interlayer welds. Hylo’s actively-heated chamber and Basis’ part-specific thermal profiles are engineered around this exact problem.
Can the Hylo actually print PEEK and ULTEM reliably?
Yes, Hylo's 250°C chamber maximizes interlayer welding while preventing premature cooling that leads to warping and cracking during the build process. AON3D recommends an 185°C chamber for ULTEM™ 9085, 210°C for ULTEM™ 1010, and 250°C for PEEK.
Is the Hylo locked to AON3D filament?
No. It is a fully open material system running any 1.75mm filament, AON3D’s own materials or your own source, with pre-configured profiles in AON3D’s free slicer for common engineering polymers.
Does the Hylo need special electrical infrastructure?
It runs on 208–240VAC, 40A single-phase power. Dynamism can walk you through facility requirements before installation.

FULLY OPEN MATERIAL SYSTEM
Print the Materials the Job Actually Needs
No proprietary filament lock-in. Hylo runs any 1.75mm filament, from ultra-performance polymers down to standard commodity-grade materials. Hylo is an open material platform not a closed ecosystem. Print AON3D-validated filament, your own qualified polymer, or a competitor’s spool, with no proprietary chips, no locked-out third-party materials, and no unlock fees.
WHO IT'S FOR
Purpose-Built for Aerospace, Defense, and Production Floors
Aerospace & Defense
PEEK and ULTEM™ parts that replace machined metal in jigs, fixtures, and end-use tooling for primes and DoD suppliers.

THE AON3D PLATFORM
The AI-Driven Workflow: From Model to High-Performance Part
Hylo provides the industrial-grade hardware, but the true power of the system is through its integration with Basis™, AI-driven physics-based thermal simulation software. Together, they turn a complex manufacturing process into a simplified, repeatable, four-step workflow.
BASIS™ IN ACTION
Integrated Quality Assurance System
Basis™ uses multiphysics simulation to optimize part-specific print settings before printing, real-time process monitoring to detect defects during the build, and digital build records to provide traceable quality evidence for verification and qualification.
Track everything in one place
Manage projects, printers and users from a single interface, this is the actual Basis™ Optimize screen.
Detect hidden print defects
Near real-time process data flags warping, cracking, and inclusions, so issues are caught and documented before parts are put into service. Every build is backed by a traceable record, giving your team confidence in every part it delivers.
Fix issues before you print
Automatically create part-specific print settings that maximizes quality and performance, no trial-and-error tuning required.
PREPARE
Streamline print preparation
Go from a model to a ready-to-print G-code file in just a few clicks, optimized specifically for your geometry and material, with full visibility across printers, projects, users, and revisions.
OPTIMIZE
Expert-level results, no expert required
AI-driven process optimization replaces trial-and-error printing, creating dynamic, geometry- and material-specific parameters that optimize layer weld strength, dimensional accuracy, surface finish, and crystallization kinetics.
ANALYZE
Digital Build Records
Basis™ creates spatially linked build records that connect Hylo's sensor data and detected anomalies to the part, supporting quality verification and qualification.
ADD-ON
Basis™ is a separate, paid add-on
Hylo’s up to 85% strength improvement is achieved with Basis™ running the print, compared to default profiles in AON3D’s free slicer. Basis™ is sold separately and available by quote only. Contact Dynamism for pricing.

INDUSTRY-LEADING FEATURES
Built to Run All Day, Every Day
The Hylo’s hardware is built out-of-the-box to handle highly abrasive, high-temperature composite filaments, and stays accurate because Basis™ software is watching the process the whole time.
Composite-Ready Hardware
Out of the box, Hylo is built to handle carbon-fiber, glass-fiber, and ESD composites, no separate hardened toolhead kit or upgrade required.
Automated XY Toolhead Alignment
Hylo uses an optical nozzle sensor, 2x more precise and 100x faster than manual calibration prints. Performed in seconds before every print.
Independent Self-Leveling Extruders
Three Z-axis motors physically level the build platform before every print, combined with customizable mesh leveling for a perfect first layer, every time.
Automated material handling
Automated material handling with humidity-controlled storage for up to four 4kg reels, plus automatic loading, unloading, and changeover.

Built for manufacturing full-scale, end-use components without bottlenecking your production floor 400 mm/s print speeds and over 8x the throughput of conventional high-temp FDM.
